name: Malta Environment Foundation grants
summary: Open call for registered environmental voluntary organisations in Malta to fund nature and environmental projects, with proposals of up to EUR 10,000 reviewed at 3-4 steering committee meetings a year.

amount.note: Cap stated for the upcoming steering committee meeting; grants under €1,000 not preferred

reporting: Grantees submit interim and final reports on dates set in the grant agreement and take part in evaluation activities.

status.quote: MEF's call for grants will remain open for the foreseeable future.

applicant_types.quote: Voluntary organisations registered with the Office of the Commissioner for Voluntary Organisations (OCVO) that have a strong focus on environmental action.

geography.quote: WHERE: Anywhere in Malta or in its territorial waters.

access.quote: Interested organisations are highly encouraged to send a short expression of interest to MEF before submitting their proposals.

window.quote: We hold 3-4 Steering Committee meetings annually, during which MEF reviews and selects successful applications.

amount.quote: For the upcoming Steering Committee meeting, MEF will consider grant proposals for amounts of up to €10,000. Please note that we prefer not to award microgrants of less than €1,000.

reporting.quote: Grantees supported under the program are required to submit interim and final reports on dates determined in the grant agreement. Organisations supported by TCEF funds can also be visited at regular intervals and meetings can be requested by STDV and the Conservation Collective. Grantees are expected to participate in various evaluation activities to measure the impact of the grant.
